title: Import-to-GMA Step1 dry-run banner is shared and independent of per-dropzone success feedback
answers: Why does the validation banner not confirm a successful file drop?
Do toasts get suppressed when the dry-run validation shows a warning/error?
How is per-file feedback surfaced when the shared config validation fails?
body: Step1Content's dry-run validation banner reflects the state of the whole config (both YAML and templates combined) and is re-run on every drop, so it cannot confirm success for an individual dropzone. Per-dropzone confirmation must use an independent mechanism (the success toast via notifyApp.success) that fires regardless of dryRunState, so it stays visible even when the banner shows warning/error.
applies: public/app/features/alerting/unified/components/import-to-gma/steps/Step1AlertmanagerResources.tsx Step1Content — any change to dropzone onDrop handlers or dry-run validation flow
